study_identification_part.si_4_title: Structural brain abnormalities and aggressive behaviour in schizophrenia: Mega-analysis of data from 2095 patients and 2861 healthy controls via the ENIGMA consortium

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study is a mega-analysis pooling data from 20 sites participating in the ENIGMA-Schizophrenia Working Group. Specific datasets mentioned that map to the guidance list include COBRE (Center for Biomedical Research Excellence), MCIC (MIND Clinical Imaging Consortium), and UMCU (Utrecht Schizophrenia project).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Data came from the Schizophrenia Working Group of the Enhancing Neuroimaging Genetics through Meta-Analysis (ENIGMA) consortium ... Twenty member sites contributed data to the current study.
